text: Designed REST APIs using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker deployed on AWS.
Engineered automated ETL pipelines in dbt, BigQuery, and Apache Airflow with SQL queries.
Fine-tuned BERT transformers using PyTorch and Hugging Face for token classification with spaCy.
Built responsive user interfaces in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Implemented distributed event streaming with Apache Kafka, Go, and Redis clusters.
Triaged security incidents in Splunk SIEM and scanned network hosts using Wireshark and Nessus.
Facilitated Agile sprint planning, Kanban boards, and Jira ticket roadmaps.
Wrote comprehensive unit and regression tests in Python using Pytest and Git for version control.
